title: Meeting with Grusch while he was undercover

tellings.quote: I met with Grush when he was still an undercover uh operative. Okay. And no one knew who he was. His bosses were the ones I was providing intel to

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher, says he met David Grusch, an intelligence officer who later went public about secret UFO programmes, while Grusch was still working undercover and nobody knew who he was. Greer tells this as something he took part in himself, on Jesse Michels's show in 2025. He adds that Grusch's bosses were the people he was passing information to, which would mean Greer had been feeding the same officials who later saw Grusch come forward.
